note: Runtime provenance for the synthdetect EVAL container (issue #144, M1 S2). NOT a shipped service image: this pins the maintainer eval runtime (Dockerfile.eval + requirements.eval.txt) that tools/synthdetect_infer.py runs inside. Fields marked null are CANDIDATE, frozen in S2b (the first GPU build + validation) against real bytes, exactly like the weight shas in tools/synthdetect_sources.py. A contract test (tests/contracts/test_synthdetect_container.py) binds this file to the Dockerfile ARG, the requirements pins, the registry, and the runner's canonicalization id.
canonicalization_note: Corpus audio is canonicalized ONCE at acquisition to 16 kHz mono signed-16-bit little-endian PCM (no dither, no normalization, no silence trim). The manifest sha256 is the sha256 of the PCM data-chunk payload bytes only (no RIFF/WAV header). The runner does NO resampling: it asserts this format, hashes the payload, and fails closed on a mismatch. Changing this canonicalization is a new id, never a silent regeneration of corpus identity.

runtime.fairseq_commit_note: Frozen S2b (2026-08-24): the fairseq revision the upstream SSL_Anti-spoofing README pins for its wav2vec2-XLS-R front end. Passed to the Dockerfile as FAIRSEQ_COMMIT (the build refuses to proceed without it); a contract test binds this value once non-null.

determinism_env.note: Baked into the image; required for torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) under CUDA. The runner asserts CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG before CUDA init and records both in the journal flags.

model_repo.commit_note: Frozen S2b (2026-08-24). The vendored model definition tools/synthdetect_vendor/ssl_antispoofing_model.py is model.py at this commit (verbatim, sha256 08b2b99b...); see tools/synthdetect_vendor/provenance.json. Mirrors tools/synthdetect_sources.py MODELS['w2v2-aasist'].commit.

weights.note: CANDIDATE weight files, mounted read-only at eval time (never baked). Logical filename + role mirror tools/synthdetect_sources.py; size_bytes and sha256 are frozen in S2b from real downloaded bytes. Qualification state advances CANDIDATE -> PINNED_UNQUALIFIED (real-byte sha verified) -> QUALIFIED (GPU determinism + smoke evidence committed).

qualification_evidence.note: The dated evidence the qualified promotion rests on. A contract test (test_qualified_state_binds_its_evidence) requires every listed report to exist whenever qualification_state is qualified, so the label cannot outrun its evidence.

weights.qualification_state_note: Qualified S2b (2026-08-24) on maintainer RTX 3060 (SM 8.6) hardware: the two weight shas below are frozen from real downloaded bytes (docs/reports/synthdetect-weight-receipt-2026-08-24.md), the GPU smoke passed (strict load, all-modules-eval, one finite score per window with correct counts and polarity, resume-without-duplication, weight/audio/header mismatch fail-closed), and the determinism spike was bit-exact across 4 cold container starts (max abs diff 0.0). See docs/reports/synthdetect-gpu-smoke-2026-08-24.md and docs/gpu-contracts.md. Qualified is a determinism + smoke claim for this frozen runtime/GPU-class/batch config, not a benchmark-reproduction claim (that is S3/S4).

scoring_semantics.journaled_score: negated output column 1 (higher = more synthetic; positive class = spoof)
scoring_semantics.note: The upstream checkpoint emits column 1 = bona-fide logit; the runner journals its negation so the stored raw score is comparable across models under the fixed polarity. Unit-tested against the fake engine.

s2b_freeze_checklist: download LA_model.pth (Google Drive) and xlsr2_300m.pt (dl.fbaipublicfiles.com); record retrieval date + authoritative URL + byte size + sha256 in a dated weight receipt
freeze fairseq_commit, base_image_digest, model_repo.commit, and the two weight shas here and in tools/synthdetect_sources.py together

build the container with --build-arg FAIRSEQ_COMMIT=<frozen>; commit a dated GPU smoke bundle (strict checkpoint load, all-modules-eval assertion, finite one-score-per-window, polarity, resume-without-duplication, deliberate-mismatch fail-closed)
run the determinism spike (>=3 cold runs; bit-for-bit identical per-window logits and pooled scores, max abs diff exactly 0); commit a dated determinism report
only then advance weights.qualification_state to qualified and flip weights_pinned() True
